answer: The circuit was not submitted, so no job ID exists. I passed the circuit unchanged to IQMClient.submit_circuits(shots=100) on garnet:mock with iqm-client 35.0.3. The client checked it against the live dynamic quantum architecture before sending anything, and that check failed. It raised exa.common.errors.iqm_error.CircuitValidationError: "('QB1', 'QB20') is not allowed as locus for 'cz'". The cause is that QB1 and QB20 are not coupled on Garnet. The live DQA (calibration set f04fe114-002f-46bd-8fa4-2a577ff56501) allows cz on QB1 only with QB2 and QB4. It allows cz on QB20 only with QB16 and QB19. A CZ between QB1 and QB20 is impossible without routing or SWAPs. As instructed, I did not change the circuit. No credits were used. To make it run, transpile against the backend or put the cz on a calibrated pair such as QB1-QB2.
